## Summary

AppLovin was added to the S&P 500 index on September 22, 2025. S&P Dow Jones Indices announced that AppLovin, Robinhood Markets, and Emcor Group will join the S&P 500, with the changes taking effect before markets opened on September 22.

AppLovin shares jumped over 11% after the S&P Dow Jones Indices announcement. The inclusion delivered immediate buying pressure from index funds, broader institutional ownership through pensions and ETFs, enhanced market credibility, and greater liquidity.

The three companies being removed from the index to make room for these additions were MarketAxess Holdings, Caesars Entertainment, and Enphase Energy.
